description: pySWAP is a Python wrapper maintained by the pySWAP project for the SWAP soil-water and crop hydrology model. It is not a reimplementation of the SWAP solver. The package helps users create input files, execute an installed SWAP model and inspect or plot results in notebooks. Inputs are soil, weather, water-management and crop settings plus the external SWAP executable; outputs are model runs and processed water-balance series for a selected field and period. Geographic coverage is user-defined. MIT-licensed source, package instructions and tutorials are public. The README calls the wrapper early-stage, so version compatibility with a local SWAP installation should be checked. A limitation is that the wrapper cannot establish calibrated groundwater or irrigation predictions without measured site data and the licensed upstream solver. pySWAP can prepare irrigation and soil-moisture scenarios. The catalogue's data-era5-reanalysis is a distinct potential weather source; no coupling was tested. No solver or field dataset was downloaded.
name: pySWAP hydrological-model workflow wrapper
